description:
Flying out to the outer planets, the HUD speed readout just says 'NaN km/s' the whole way. Looks completely broken.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: (a) whether the destination-aware Hohmann approximation (R_EARTH + R_dest)/2 is the correct model for outer-planet HUD speeds on /fly, or (b) whether the speed should come from the actual Lambert-solver trajectory parameters (which would require a different data flow), or (c) some other expected behavior.
A: Neither (a) nor (b). The transfer semi-major axis input itself is not what I'm reporting — keep the inputs as they are; the speed function's out-of-range behavior is the bug. The expected fix is purely in the speed function's fallback: beyond apohelion it should return the local circular orbital speed (sqrt(mu / r)), and at radius = 0 it should return 0. No change to how the transfer semi-major axis is computed.
